all.mapped_by: hand, from the household pilot's core_kind 'tcn_w'
all.why: 'tcn' is the dilated causal residual Conv1D family of 'fused_branches', the inline family closest to the pilot's tcn_w core

core.why: the household pilot's core is 'tcn_w' in native df_e1 code, which no predictor.plugins entry point names; the declared plugin closest to it is 'fused_branches' with one branch and its 'tcn' encoder

decisions_refused.question: grouping_cut
decisions_refused.why: the choice 'k=1' is not one of the declared options ['k=2', 'k=3', 'k=4', 'k=5', 'k=6']; a person may not add an option to a set the executing repository declared

decisions_refused.question: extractor
decisions_refused.why: the choice 'tcn' is not one of the declared options ['default', 'ann', 'rnn', 'transformer', 'lstm', 'cnn', 'vae', 'vae_small']; a person may not add an option to a set the executing repository declared

grouping.why: held at the baseline_hand grouping: every meter column in one block. The candidate is a REPRESENTATION, and it declares no grouping; taking another one here would confound the contrast this stage exists to measure.

not_decided.calendar.clock: a file of timestamps cannot say whether they are a publication clock or a receipt clock; 'receipt' is written so the spec validates and a person must confirm it (--clock)
not_decided.exogenous: the other numeric columns are offered as names only; whether each is available at prediction time is not a property of this file
not_decided.holdout: the cut is a decision about what must stay unseen, which no test on the data can make; {"fraction": 0.2} is a convention, not a measurement
not_decided.sampling.timezone: the timestamps carry no offset, so 'UTC' is what --timezone declared, not what was read

why.features: none: the peak's period matches no calendar period feature-eng builds a feature for
why.transform: level: the stationarity verdict is STATIONARY (adf+kpss agree)
why.windows: ACF peak at lag 2892 (rho 0.244256, band 0.011206, computed on the levels) -> window 2892; the decay lag 197 is kept as the shorter window

why: WP06 stage 3: the design candidate 'seasonal_lag_2892', fitted with the rest of the pipeline held at exactly what the baseline_hand stage uses (one group of every meter column, the 'tcn' encoder family of 'fused_branches', no per-feature preprocessor declared, the same epochs, patience, seed, batch size and deterministic ops). The representation is therefore the only thing that differs from the baseline, and the only thing a difference in the table can be attributed to.
